title: Kwai Summary Attention V2 Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.18654v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Summary-token architectures such as Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) compress distant context into learnable Summary token per chunk, and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. In such hybrid KSA-Full architecture, the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. Although effective, however, it also introduce some bottlenecks: (1) the different layers summary compression chunk must be same, therefore hard to reach a flexible KV Cache compression, e.g., different layer set different summary compression chunk window. (2) in the full-attention layers, the summary token introduced additional computation cost, but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling, therefore unfriendly to the computation side. Motivated by them, we developed the KSA V2, which not only achieves a more flexible KV cache memory compression

translated_title: 快手摘要注意力 V2 技术报告
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.18654v1 公告类型：cross  摘要：诸如快手摘要注意力（KSA）之类的摘要标记架构，将远距离上下文压缩为每个分块中可学习的摘要标记，混合变体则将这些层与全注意力层交错排列，以保留对原始文本的精确访问。在这种混合 KSA-Full 架构中，交错插入的摘要标记在不同层之间充当流式传输的角色。尽管有效，但它也引入了一些瓶颈：(1) 不同层的摘要压缩分块必须相同，因此难以实现灵活的 KV 缓存压缩，例如无法为不同层设置不同的摘要压缩分块窗口。(2) 在全注意力层中，摘要标记引入了额外的计算成本，但该层却忽略它们，仍然支付二次方复杂度的预填充开销，因此对计算端不友好。受此启发，我们开发了 KSA V2，它不仅实现了更灵活的 KV 缓存内存压缩……
tldr: 提出KSA V2架构，通过允许不同层设置不同的摘要压缩分块窗口，实现更灵活的KV缓存内存压缩，并解决全注意力层中摘要标记带来的额外计算开销问题。
en_tdlr: KSA V2 enables more flexible KV cache memory compression by allowing different summary compression chunk windows across layers, while addressing the additional computational overhead of summary tokens in full-attention layers.
